title: Color test
description: The 360x640 run screen in Endesga 32: zone colours, UI colours, outline styles, card dimming and lane readability. Sprites are drawn in code as stand-ins.

title: Start screen
description: A proposal for the screen before a walk: bank and best walk, the walker and pack at the gate on Maple Street, the dog picker, gear, logbook and Start walk. Interactive, with sample data.

title: Help screen
description: A proposal for the in-game How to walk screen: six pages, each with an illustration from the real sprites and a few lines drafted from the rulebook.

title: Menus
description: The pause menu and settings over the dimmed road, the end screen at sunset and the Stats page with the badge wall, drawn from the exported UI kit and BMFonts. Interactive, with sample data.

title: Run screen
description: The new run screen with the real art: top bar and state strip, zone backdrop, doghouse column and the pseudo-3D road with the pack, pickups, obstacles, moving hazards and every hit moment. Interactive, with sample data.

title: 80s style
description: Three 80s box-art directions (Chrome & Sunset, Rainbow Cloud, Box Art Lineup) side by side: logo and tagline, the 360x560 home screen, a UI kit and the site hero at desktop and phone width.
